newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Essar, Motorola, in Indian cable deal.
newsitem.headline: Essar, Motorola, in Indian cable deal.

text.p: Motorola Inc said on Monday its multi-media group had agreed a contract with Essar Commvision Ltd for the installation of up to 2,000 cable telephony lines in India.
Motorola said in a statement the project would also pass 3,000 homes with hybrid-fiber coaxial cable.
A company spokesman told Reuters the initial contract was worth aound US$5 million but could eventually be worth much more.
He declined to give details but said the company would make a further annuncement later on Monday.
Motorola said Essar Commvision, a joint venture between India's Essar Group and Bell Atlantic Corp, was the first Indian telecommunications company to deploy cable telephony.
Under the initial contract, Motorola will help Essar develop from a cellular operator into a full multi-media service provider, it said.
Essar Commvision is expected to become the third company in India to sign a basic telephone licence, according to A.V. Gokak, chairman of the government's Telecom Commission.
He told reporters last month the government expected Essar to sign a licence for the northern state of Punjab.
